name: Slovak Business Angels Network
decision_note: Business-angel network (the network organises, members invest) - a real investor channel but not type vc, so out of the Slovak VC reference set.

evidence.quote: It’s the first business angels’ network in the Slovak Republic which gathers entrepreneurs and managers that are willing to invest into promising projects and support startups with unique expertise.
The typical investment range is between €10-80k but it varies depending on many factors.
Klub podnikateľských anjelov Slovenska založili Slovak Business Agency a Združenie mladých podnikateľov Slovenska.

analyst_notes: Screened only to the depth needed for an S1 exclusion. Vestbee (article first published 2020-10-08, modified 2024-02-21) describes 'Slovak Business Angels' as the first Slovak business-angel network with typical tickets of EUR 10-80k (e1, e2). Podnikajte.sk says the Klub podnikateľských anjelov Slovenska (founded 2011 per earlier desk research) was set up by Slovak Business Agency and ZMPS (e3); treating SBAN and the club as the same network is an assumption, not confirmed by a source. No website resolved (sban.sk does not resolve), no ORSR/RÚZ legal entity found under these names (likely a civic association or SBA programme), and no dated network-announced deal since 2024-10-25 was found; web search was unavailable during this pass, so activity was not checked exhaustively. Its members' deals, if any, would be angel records (type angel), outside this VC pilot.
